newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Telebras outperforms Bovespa index.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Telebras outperforms Bovespa index.

text.p: Preferred shares of benchmark Telebras rose 61.93 percent in the January-to-August period, outperforming a 45.60 percent rise in the Bovespa index, Telebras said in a statement.
The company's common stock rose 62.98 percent in the first eight months of the year, the statement said.

Last month, Telebras shares represented 71.98 percent of trade in the spot market on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa). Between January and August, the firm's shares accounted for 64.79 percent on average of the bourse's monthly trade in the spot market, against 48.55 percent in the same period of 1995.

Telebras also said its stock was the ninth-heaviest traded on the New York Stock Exchange in August, with a daily average volume of $110.3 million. From November 1995, when the firm's ADRs were launched, through August 1996, Telebras rose 83.72 percent on the NYSE, the statement added.
